blocks.text: 新变化：

inlines.text: 新变化：
Claude 可以在你打开的工具中工作。
你可以让 Claude 修改你正打开的页面、表格行或文件，并像批准连接器操作那样批准它的操作。Claude 做出修改时，改动会实时显示在工具中，你可以同步继续工作。
整个工具会在对话旁边打开。
你可以在工具中工作并隐藏聊天，或在需要空间时切换到全屏。对于 Confluence 或 Notion 这类工具，这意味着你能获得登录自己账户的完整编辑器，而不是受限的预览。
直接打开已连接的工具，无需编写 Claude 提示词。
需要 Claude 帮忙时，你可以在同一屏幕中直接提问。
固定你最常用的工具。
你可以将它们与你的 artifacts 一起排列，并通过侧边栏和 + 菜单一键访问。

blocks.text: 以下是目前 Claude 中部分可用工具能做的事情：

inlines.text: 以下是目前 Claude 中部分可用工具能做的事情：
Adobe。
让 Claude 修饰、编辑照片并添加效果；高亮、编辑和遮盖 PDF。
Atlassian。
在聊天旁边打开 Confluence 页面，让 Claude 撰写和编辑，并实时查看它在页面上的修改。
Box。
在聊天旁边打开 Box 文件，让 Claude 修改，并在保留更改前并排比较版本。
HubSpot。
确定销售管道任务和后续跟进的优先级，然后在 Claude 中执行。
Notion。
让 Claude 创建 Notion 文档或数据库。边聊边构建，或自行编辑，无需离开 Claude。

blocks.text: Earlier this year, we launched interactive connectors to bring a small live view of tools into Claude. Starting today, where a connector supports it, you can open a tool beside your conversation or expand it to full screen, and ask Claude to work alongside you and make changes directly.

inlines.text: Earlier this year, we launched
interactive connectors

to bring a small live view of tools into Claude. Starting today, where a connector supports it, you can open a tool beside your conversation or expand it to full screen, and ask Claude to work alongside you and make changes directly.

blocks.text: This is rolling out on the web and in the Claude desktop app on all plans, as part of the new Claude experience that brings chat and Cowork together. You’ll see these features once your account is updated with the new Claude or your organization turns it on.

inlines.text: This is rolling out on the web and in the Claude desktop app on all plans, as part of the
new Claude experience
that brings chat and Cowork together. You’ll see these features once your account is updated with the new Claude or your organization turns it on.

blocks.text: What’s new:

inlines.text: What’s new:
Claude can work in your open tools.

You can ask Claude to make changes to a page, row, or file that you have open and approve its actions the same way you approve a connector’s actions. Changes appear in the tool as Claude makes them, so you can keep working right alongside it.
The whole tool
opens next to your conversation.

You can work in the tool and hide the chat or go full screen when you need room. For tools like Confluence or Notion, that means you get the full editor, signed into your own account, rather than a limited preview.
Open a connected tool directly, without having to write a Claude prompt.
When you want Claude’s help, you can ask from the same screen.
Pin the tools you use most.
You can arrange them alongside your artifacts and access them with one click in your sidebar and the + menu.

inlines.text: Work with Claude in the tools you use

blocks.text: We’re starting with a small group of tools from our directory, including Asana, Canva, Carta, Dropbox, monday.com, Smartsheet, Vercel, and Webflow.

blocks.text: Here’s what you can do with some of the tools available in Claude today:

inlines.text: Here’s what you can do with some of the tools available in Claude today:
Adobe.
Ask Claude to retouch, edit and add effects to photos; highlight, edit and redact PDFs.
Atlassian.
Open a Confluence page beside your chat, ask Claude to write and edit, and review its changes live on the page.
Box.
Open a Box file beside your chat, ask Claude to revise it, and compare the versions side by side before you keep the changes.
HubSpot.
Prioritize pipeline tasks and follow-ups, then act on them in Claude.
Notion.
Ask Claude to create a Notion doc or database. Build as you chat, or edit it yourself, without leaving Claude.

blocks.text: For developers: built on MCP Apps

inlines.text: For developers: built on MCP Apps

blocks.text: Interactive connectors run on MCP Apps, the open extension to the Model Context Protocol that lets an MCP server bring its own interface into AI applications. An MCP App you build isn’t limited to Claude and can run in any AI application that supports the extension.

inlines.text: Interactive connectors run on MCP Apps, the open extension to the
Model Context Protocol
that lets an MCP server bring its own interface into AI applications. An MCP App you build isn’t limited to Claude and can run in any AI application that supports the
extension

blocks.text: Until now, MCP Apps in Claude have mainly appeared as interactive views in the conversation. Claude now supports more of the extension, such as app tools, along with embedded sites, so a developer’s full app can run inside Claude.
